headline: Argentina Enters November With Regulated Tariff Hikes Following Sub-2% October CPI
summary: Argentina is raising bus fares, private healthcare premiums, rents, highway tolls, and utility rates in November. Private consultants estimate October monthly inflation stood between 1.8% and 2.0%, close to September's 1.7% reading.
why: Argentina's disinflation trajectory under President Javier Milei is crucial for fiscal stabilization, sovereign risk spreads, and ongoing currency control liberalization.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Regulated price adjustments test headline inflation consolidation around the 2% monthly mark.
